papers.title: MoDr: Mixture-of-Depth-Recurrent Transformers for Test-Time Reasoning
papers.desc: Introduces MoDr, which adds multi-branch routing to a depth-recurrent Transformer so looped models can explore solution paths more adaptively at test time.

papers.title: Polymorphic Universal Transformer
papers.desc: Introduces the Polymorphic Universal Transformer, adding conditional sparse subspaces and uncertainty-aware depth scheduling to shared-parameter recurrence to reduce compute while mitigating representational collapse.

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
papers.desc: Argues that once a looped language model's recurrent states approach fixed points, the endpoint can replace the trajectory, enabling truncated backpropagation, terminal KV sharing, distilled prefill up to 1.79x faster, and RL updates from saved rollout states about 2x faster; it shapes those fixed points with a depth prior learned from prediction feedback plus an entropy term and with orthogonal input injection, and at 1.6B parameters the learned prior with a 3x smaller KV cache matches the downstream average of fixed-depth training with the full cache.

papers.title: Universal Speech Transformer
papers.desc: Adapts the Universal Transformer to speech recognition with shared iterative encoder and decoder computation, dynamic depth, one-time positional encoding, and full hidden-state updates.
